concept: Fight Night - a gritty, disciplined combat-sport palette. Signal-red primary throws the punch, gunmetal steel grounds it with discipline, and an electric-orange accent adds high-energy spark. Near-black ink sits on warm cream canvas, with optional dark gunmetal panels for bold, arena-lit contrast.
contrastNotes: ink #15110F on bg #F7F3EC = 16.97:1 (>=7 PASS). ink-soft #595049 on bg = 7.12:1 (>=4.5 PASS). White on primary #C81E2D = 5.71:1 (>=4.5 PASS). Primary on bg = 5.16:1 (>=3 PASS). Bonus: white on primary-dark #9E1622 = 8.1:1; secondary #3A444E on bg = 9.3:1. surface-alt #17191D is a dark gunmetal panel for arena-lit sections (use cream/white text on it). Accent #F4641C is reserved for highlights and CTA sparks; pair with ink, not white, for small text.
